selections.text:
- build_id: extend-course-to-functional-laptop-llm-20260810
    objective: "Extend the from-scratch reference core with a production-shaped, laptop-feasible path whose final Rust system can prepare realistic data, train and fully resume, evaluate, adapt, generate, and serve a functional decoder-only autoregressive text LLM without implying validated production scale or state-of-the-art quality."
    status: active

- id: establish-functional-firefox-execution-boundary
        objective: "Provision the repository's locked Playwright Firefox in the existing course Dockerfile and validate the existing Chapter 39 browser baseline through ./course."
        depends_on:
          - establish-ch40-course-toolchain-v2
        status: "completed"

- id: establish-functional-successor-static-integration
        objective: "Create reusable cumulative-Rust, bilingual static-route, review-receipt and validation infrastructure without publishing a partial chapter."
        depends_on:
          - "reframe-functional-reference-core-surfaces"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch40-reference-core-handoff
        objective: "Establish the hash-bound handoff from the 1,188-parameter scalar reference core to the separately measured functional laptop track without transferring laptop-scale claims."
        depends_on:
          - "establish-functional-successor-static-integration"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch41-governed-corpus-acquisition
        objective: "Define and execute a governed, restart-safe corpus acquisition protocol on bounded offline fixtures before any bulk corpus bytes are eligible."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch40-reference-core-handoff"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch42-deterministic-corpus-filtering
        objective: "Apply deterministic quality, language, privacy and refusal filtering with exact reject reasons and preserved provenance."
        depends_on:
          - "acquire-functional-tinystories-raw-pair"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch43-deduplication-decontamination
        objective: "Deduplicate and decontaminate train/evaluation data with exact identity, threshold, split and leakage receipts."
        depends_on:
          - "execute-functional-corpus-filtering"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch44-scalable-bpe-tokenizer
        objective: "Train and apply a scalable course-owned BPE tokenizer whose configuration and corpus identity remain explicit."
        depends_on:
          - "execute-functional-corpus-dedup-split"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch45-padded-variable-batches
        objective: "Make variable-length padded batches equivalent to unpadded examples at valid tokens with exact attention and loss masks."
        depends_on:
          - "execute-functional-tokenizer-and-tokenized-splits"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch46-packed-sequence-masks
        objective: "Pack documents with segment identities, position policy, no-cross-document attention and valid-token gradient equivalence."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch45-padded-variable-batches"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch47-depth-stable-decoder
        objective: "Keep activations and gradients inside predeclared bounds as decoder depth increases through course-owned initialization and residual scaling."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch46-packed-sequence-masks"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch48-configurable-decoder-core
        objective: "Drive the same causal decoder through reference, bridge, laptop and plan-only scales with runtime configuration and one private prepared-input seam."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch47-depth-stable-decoder"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch49-dropout-semantics
        objective: "Implement training-only dropout with explicit RNG, resume and evaluation semantics without changing the decoder family."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch48-configurable-decoder-core"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch50-dependency-error-contract
        objective: "Freeze supporting-library call-site boundaries and stable typed errors before admitting new backends or crates."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch49-dropout-semantics"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch51-serving-config-admission
        objective: "Project one semantic configuration into serving capacities and refuse inadmissible plans before allocation."
        depends_on:
          - "admit-functional-supporting-dependency-graph"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch52-accelerator-tensor-parity
        objective: "Run the same course tensor semantics on scalar and admitted accelerator backends with measured dtype parity and no hidden fallback."
        depends_on:
          - "establish-functional-gpu-execution-boundary"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch53-mixed-precision-training
        objective: "Train with admitted mixed precision, master-state and loss-scaling rules while exposing numerical failure evidence."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch52-accelerator-tensor-parity"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch54-memory-bounded-training
        objective: "Bound memory through accumulation and activation checkpointing while preserving update and gradient semantics."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch53-mixed-precision-training"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch55-optimizer-schedules-clipping
        objective: "Implement clipping, schedules and AdamW update order as course-owned learner evidence."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch54-memory-bounded-training"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch56-tensor-artifact-interchange
        objective: "Read and write bounded tensor interchange artifacts with exact dtype, shape, byte, identity and admission checks."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch55-optimizer-schedules-clipping"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch57-immutable-artifact-persistence
        objective: "Persist immutable model, tokenizer, configuration, lineage and receipt DAGs without mutable identity ambiguity."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch56-tensor-artifact-interchange"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch58-exact-job-resume
        objective: "Resume a complete training job exactly across parameters, optimizer, schedule, scaler, sampler, RNG, counters and artifacts."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch57-immutable-artifact-persistence"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch59-resource-observability
        objective: "Measure admitted versus observed resources, throughput and numerical events using stable units and identities."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch58-exact-job-resume"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch60-multi-seed-evaluation
        objective: "Evaluate multiple fixed training seeds with conventional denominators, contamination controls, spread and uncertainty."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch59-resource-observability"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch61-quantized-gguf-artifacts
        objective: "Implement the course quantizer and bounded GGUF v3 parser/writer, admission and lineage path against hand-built and independently produced tiny course fixtures; reject arbitrary tensor types, families and mmproj without claiming selected-base integration."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch60-multi-seed-evaluation"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch62-laptop-hardware-admission
        objective: "Plan and admit exact laptop workloads against measured hardware caps before allocation or long execution."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch61-quantized-gguf-artifacts"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch63-gqa-context-policy
        objective: "Implement actual grouped-query attention used by both laptop scale tuples and expose context-policy consequences."
        depends_on:
          - "freeze-functional-from-scratch-experiment"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch64-online-tiled-attention
        objective: "Implement bounded online tiled attention with scalar-oracle equivalence before long GPU runs."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch63-gqa-context-policy"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch65-kv-block-pool
        objective: "Allocate and reclaim block-based KV state with cursors, bounds and per-request isolation."
        depends_on:
          - "execute-functional-from-scratch-pretraining"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch66-nucleus-penalties-logprobs
        objective: "Implement exact nucleus sets, penalties and per-token log probabilities without corrupting reusable logits."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch65-kv-block-pool"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch67-stop-strings-unicode-streaming
        objective: "Stop on multi-token strings and stream Unicode safely across token and byte boundaries."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch66-nucleus-penalties-logprobs"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch68-continuous-batch-scheduling
        objective: "Continuously admit variable requests and complete them independently while preserving serial equivalence."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch67-stop-strings-unicode-streaming"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch69-cancellation-backpressure-budgets
        objective: "Cancel and reclaim resources under bounded queues, timeouts, budgets and slow-client backpressure."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch68-continuous-batch-scheduling"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch70-loopback-serving-metrics
        objective: "Serve only on loopback by default with stable request/resource/latency metrics and config projection."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch69-cancellation-backpressure-budgets"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch71-lora-sft-adapters
        objective: "Implement course-owned LoRA and response-masked SFT while proving the base remains frozen."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch70-loopback-serving-metrics"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch72-direct-preference-optimization
        objective: "Implement one bounded direct preference objective with exact reference-policy and chosen/rejected log-probability evidence."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch71-lora-sft-adapters"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch73-qlora-boundary
        objective: "Compare a bounded QLoRA formulation without hiding quantization or adapter decisions behind a library."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch72-direct-preference-optimization"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch74-prefix-cache-reuse
        objective: "Reuse prefix-cache blocks only under exact token, config, artifact and authorization identities."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch73-qlora-boundary"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch75-rope-context-scaling
        objective: "Expose RoPE context-scaling assumptions and refuse unsupported extrapolation rather than claiming arbitrary context."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch74-prefix-cache-reuse"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch76-retrieval-provenance
        objective: "Retrieve authorized text with exact top-k ordering, provenance and authorization before ranking."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch75-rope-context-scaling"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch77-constrained-json-decoding
        objective: "Constrain decoder output to a declared JSON grammar while preserving token-level evidence and failure semantics."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch76-retrieval-provenance"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch78-authorized-tools
        objective: "Execute only explicitly authorized tools across a typed trust boundary with text-token reintegration."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch77-constrained-json-decoding"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch79-safety-privacy-model-card
        objective: "Measure bounded safety and privacy fixtures and publish an honest model card without a general-safety claim."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch78-authorized-tools"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch80-from-scratch-laptop-capstone
        objective: "Reproduce the governed narrow-domain from-scratch laptop run, exact resume, held-out evidence and selected generated/served artifact without general-purpose claims."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch79-safety-privacy-model-card"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch81-import-adapt-serve-capstone
        objective: "Bind the real SFT-to-DPO successor and its course-produced quantized identity, then import, adapt, evaluate and continuously serve that exact selected compatible model."
        depends_on:
          - "execute-functional-direct-preference-update"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch82-advanced-decoding-serving
        objective: "Compare advanced decoding and serving policies under explicit bounded simulation or laptop evidence."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch81-import-adapt-serve-capstone"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch83-distributed-schedule-simulation
        objective: "Simulate distributed schedules and communication exactly while labeling multi-device execution unvalidated."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch82-advanced-decoding-serving"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch84-moe-routing-simulation
        objective: "Simulate MoE routing, capacity and load-balancing exactly while labeling production MoE execution unvalidated."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch83-distributed-schedule-simulation"
        status: "pending"

- id: implement-ch85-persistence-scale-decision
        objective: "Measure the fixed persistence workload and either retain bounded exact storage or trigger the exact conditional PostgreSQL/pgvector branch."
        depends_on:
          - "implement-ch84-moe-routing-simulation"
        status: "pending"
